root_idea.summary: The root centers on twisting or turning something.
root_idea.development: Physical twisting extends to twisted fibers, cords, and compact forms; it also develops into turning someone aside, turning away, and the figurative Qur'anic expression for the smallest possible amount.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized nominal citation form فَتِيل.

senses.definition: The slightest amount, smallest share, or least possible due.
senses.usage_conditions: Used figuratively in the Qur'anic idiom وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا, meaning that no one is deprived even of the smallest right or amount; the expression evokes a tiny twisted filament or thread.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To twist an object, such as a rope or wick.
To make or be firm and compact in build, as though tightly twisted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression مُحْكَمُ الفَتْلِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn someone away from an aim, course, or opinion, especially by deception or beguilement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a person's need, way, judgment, or sentiment; the idiom may describe turning one's face away as well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to be smooth or flaccid in the skin of the armpit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the camel's skin and armpit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of certain trees, to put forth or produce a فَتْلَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of the trees السَّلَم and السَّمُر and their feminine forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become twisted, as a rope or similar object.
To turn away from prayer or from one's course; to depart or return turning away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe turning away after prayer or returning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel's condition in which the forelegs or elbows are separated widely from the sides, or are firmly and deeply inserted in relation to the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description, also associated with a defect when applied to the lower leg or foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A twisting or a twist.
Intense firmness or compactness of the flesh and sinews of the forearm.
A twisted strip or slip formed by slitting the ear of a she-camel.
A needleful of thread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later usage noted as current in the source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A botanical term for the seed-vessel, blossom, fruit, or compact undeveloped appendage of certain thorn trees, including non-expanding leaf-like growths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact plant referent varies by usage and authority; the common descriptive idea is a compact or twisted-looking plant growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manner of twisting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression فِتْلَةٌ بَارِحَةٌ denotes an unusual or contrary manner of twisting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Twisted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a rope or similar object; the intensified form may describe multiple twisted items, including wicks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slender cord or fastening made from fibers, bark, plaited palm leaves, or thongs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for a cord fastened to a ring or to the meeting point of parts of a plough.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tent or covering placed over a wound.
A small roll of dirt or thread twisted between the fingers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This concrete object also supplies the basis for proverbial use of فَتِيلٌ for something extremely trifling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fine filament or pellicle in the cleft of a date stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is distinguished from the قِطْمِير, the thin outer integument of the date stone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wick, including a hempen match.
A suppository.
A plant with leaves resembling senna and yellow blossoms.
The bulbul; the bird's cry is also called the cry of الفَتَّال.
Having the camel's elbows or forelegs widely separated from the sides, or, of a she-camel, being heavy and curved in the hind legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective chiefly applied to camels and their limbs; its feminine is فَتْلَاءُ and its plural is فُتْلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Compact or firm in make, especially strong or firm in the forearm, as though twisted.

cautions: The Qur'anic expression فَتِيلًا is securely used for the smallest amount or share, while the lexical explanations preserve more than one associated concrete image: a fine filament in the cleft of a date stone and a small thread or roll of dirt twisted between the fingers.
